sessionMemoryExceededWarning:
Your session exceeded the browser memory limit and the structure stopped loading. You can switch to the server as the render location to view this data.

If you choose Continue, some features may not work as expected and your session could fail. To minimize memory usage, you can set Render Acceleration to Fastest. You can also prevent automatic loading of the entire assembly by doing one or both of the following: filtering your structure before viewing it or setting the AWC_visAllOn preference to False.
renderingNotSupported: Your browser is not configured to allow the client as the render location. Enable WebGL in your browser or add support for the server as the render location to your environment.​
csrNotSupportedSsrSupported: Your browser is not configured to allow the client as the render location. Enable WebGL in your browser or switch the current render location to the server.
sessionMemoryExceededWarningWithNoSSR:
Your session exceeded the browser memory limit and the structure stopped loading. You can configure and use the server as render location to view this data. 

If you continue using the client as the render location, some features may not work as expected and your session could fail. To minimize memory usage, you can set Render Acceleration to Fastest. You can also prevent automatic loading of the entire assembly by doing one or both of the following: filtering your structure before viewing it or setting the AWC_visAllOn preference to False.
